create_HTML_report: create an HTML report page with a title and auto-refresh interval using the HTML class
add_header_to_HTML: add a text header to the HTML document using the add_header method
add_images_to_HTML: add a row of clickable images with captions and hyperlinks to the HTML page
add_videos_to_HTML: add a row of clickable video players with captions and hyperlinks to the HTML page
save_HTML_to_disk: save the generated HTML document to an index.html file on disk
